summary: Completed testing of new chat delete features: 1) Delete private chat conversation - either member can delete, 2) Delete individual messages - only sender can delete their own messages, 3) Delete group chat - only owner can delete. All 8 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified delete buttons are visible and functional.
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/chat/threads/{thread_id} endpoint correctly handles: team chat (400 error), group chat (owner only), private chat (either member)
DELETE /api/chat/threads/{thread_id}/messages/{message_id} endpoint correctly validates: only sender can delete their own message
Frontend delete conversation button (trash icon) visible in private chat header with title='Delete conversation'
Frontend message delete button appears on hover with title='Delete message' - uses opacity transition for smooth UX
Confirmation dialog shown before deleting private chat or group chat
Toast notifications confirm successful deletion ('Message deleted!', 'Conversation deleted!')
seed_data_creation: Test private chats and messages created during testing. Test data prefixed with 'TEST_' or 'DELETE_ME_' for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat delete features fully tested and working. Backend endpoints tested: DELETE /api/chat/threads/{thread_id} (private chat, group chat, team chat rejection), DELETE /api/chat/threads/{thread_id}/messages/{message_id}. Frontend UI verified: delete conversation button in private chat header, message delete button on hover. WordPress REST API integration remains MOCKED.

delete_private_chat.details: Either member of a private chat can delete the conversation. Backend returns 200 with {deleted: true}. All messages in thread are also deleted.

delete_individual_message.details: Only the message sender can delete their own message. Backend returns 200 with {deleted: true, message_id: ...}. Message is removed from chat for everyone.

delete_group_chat.details: Only the group owner can delete the group. Non-owners receive 403 error. All messages in group are deleted.

cannot_delete_team_chat.details: Team chat cannot be deleted. Backend returns 400 with 'Cannot delete the team chat' message.

delete_button_ui_private_chat.details: Trash icon button visible in private chat header with title='Delete conversation'. Clicking opens confirmation dialog.

delete_button_ui_message.details: Small trash button appears on hover to the left of user's own messages. Has title='Delete message'. Uses opacity transition (group-hover:opacity-100).

delete_confirmation_dialog.details: AlertDialog component shows confirmation before deletion with Cancel and Delete buttons. Delete button is red (bg-red-500).

delete_toast_notifications.details: Toast notifications confirm successful deletion: 'Message deleted!' and 'Conversation deleted!'
